The message from the facilities team is a reminder about scheduled HVAC maintenance on building B, floor 3, which will take place on Saturday, October 17, from 6am to 2pm. The maintenance will cause the west wing to lose cooling, but the east wing will remain unaffected. They also mention that if the lab freezers on that floor are affected, samples should be moved to the floor 2 units by Friday's end of day.

This message does not require direct action from you, as it appears to be informational and the requested action (moving samples) is directed at the lab personnel, not you specifically. However, you may want to take note of the maintenance schedule in case it affects your plans or work on Saturday.
